court: High Court of Judicature at Madras

parties.respondent_defendant: The District Collector, Collectorate, Karur and The Revenue Divisional Officer, Office of R.D.O., Karur

facts_of_case: Petitioner's father was an office assistant who died in 2005. Petitioner's mother gave representations for compassionate appointment from 2006 to 2011. Petitioner also gave a representation in 2011. First respondent rejected the application on 02.08.2013.

legal_principles.principle: An application for compassionate appointment can be made by a person immediately after attaining the majority.
legal_principles.held: This Court has held in very many cases that application for compassionate appointment can be made by a person immediately after attaining the majority and therefore, there cannot be any impediment for the respondent to consider the request of the petitioner.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the respondent to consider the request of the petitioner.
legal_principles.held: Therefore, it cannot be said that the application filed by the petitioner is the first application from the family that too, after a period of three years.

outcome.final_order: Court directed respondents to provide petitioner with a Government Job in place of her father's job within stipulated time.

use_for_drafting: quashing an order on compassionate grounds
